questions.question: Day 11 Practice (Process Improvements & Feedback (Phase 2)): When talking about tidying up the room (every morning), which sentence is grammatically correct for 'My sister'?

options.a: He is tidy up room.
options.b: I am tidying up the room right now.
options.c: I was tidying up the room right now.
options.d: I am tidy up room.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option B
Natural everyday English uses standard tense agreement: "I am tidying up the room right now.".

questions.question: Day 11 Vocabulary (Process Improvements & Feedback (Phase 2)): What is the exact practical meaning of the phrase 'pick out'?

options.a: To clean or inspect a physical room thoroughly.
options.b: To perform a daily task hastily without preparation.
options.c: To postpone or cancel an activity indefinitely.
options.d: Carefully choose specific items from a group.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option D
'pick out' means: carefully choose specific items from a group. Example: "Could you help me pick out the best mangos?"

questions.question:
Day 11 Translation Scenario 1 (Process Improvements & Feedback (Phase 2)):

Telugu: "నేను సాధారణంగా ఉదయం 6 గంటలకే నిద్రలేచి ఒక కప్పు టీ తాగుతాను."
(Literal attempt: "I generally in morning 6 clock wake up drink tea.")

options.a: Literal Indian English phrasing without modal polite verbs.
options.b: I am needing to i generally in morning 6 clock wake up drink tea.
options.c: I generally in morning 6 clock wake up drink tea.
options.d: I usually wake up at 6:00 AM and have a cup of tea.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option D
Natural Version: "I usually wake up at 6:00 AM and have a cup of tea."

Use 'have a cup of tea' and specify time as '6:00 AM'.
